name: Vercel
headline: Frontend hosting + edge functions on Vercel's global network.
free_tier_summary: Hobby plan: unlimited static hosting, 100 GB bandwidth/month, serverless + edge functions, preview deploys. No CC required.
notes: Best-in-class Next.js host. Commercial-use restrictions on Hobby plan.

name: Render
headline: Web services with 750 hrs/mo. Free Postgres for 90 days.
free_tier_summary: Free Web Services with 750 hrs/month, free Postgres (1 GB, 90-day expiry), free Static Sites, free Cron Jobs.
notes: Free Web Services spin down after 15 min idle. Postgres free tier expires after 90 days.

name: Cloudflare Workers
headline: Edge serverless with 100k requests/day, 10ms CPU per request.
free_tier_summary: Pages: unlimited static, 500 builds/month. Workers: 100k req/day, 10ms CPU. R2: 10 GB. D1 SQL: 5 GB.
notes: Most generous edge platform free tier. Edge-only runtime (no Node APIs).

name: Fly.io
headline: App hosting close to users (global edge VMs).
free_tier_summary: Free trial $5 credit; pay-as-you-go after. Small apps fit in trial indefinitely.
notes: No always-free tier as of 2026. Trial credit only.

name: Google Colab
headline: Free Jupyter notebooks with T4 / L4 GPU access.
free_tier_summary: Free tier: T4/L4 GPU (~12 hr/day, dynamic), 12 GB RAM. Disconnects on inactivity.
notes: Best free GPU for ML experimentation. Sessions terminate on idle.

name: Kaggle Notebooks
headline: Free P100 / T4 GPU + TPU notebooks, 30 hrs/week.
free_tier_summary: 30 hrs/week GPU (P100 or 2x T4), 20 hrs/week TPU. 16 GB RAM.
notes: Most stable free GPU; persistent sessions.

name: Groq
headline: Free LLM inference up to 14,400 req/day across Llama-3 + Mixtral.
free_tier_summary: Free tier: ~30 req/min, ~14k req/day on Llama-3.3-70B + others. Whisper STT free.
notes: Fastest hosted LLM inference. Quotas reset daily.

name: OpenRouter
headline: Unified API; many free models from multiple labs.
free_tier_summary: Free `:free` model variants (DeepSeek, Qwen, Llama, Gemini Flash). Per-model RPM caps.
notes: Drop-in OpenAI-compatible. Free models are rate-limited.

name: Google AI Studio
headline: Gemini Flash / Pro free API — text + vision + 1M context.
free_tier_summary: Gemini 2.0 Flash: ~1500 req/day free. Vision-capable. 1M context window.
notes: Most generous free vision-capable LLM.

name: Hugging Face
headline: Serverless inference for 100k+ open models. Spaces with 16 GB RAM CPU.
free_tier_summary: Free with rate caps; covers text / image / embedding / STT / TTS via Inference API. Free Spaces hosting on CPU.
notes: Best for trying many models without lock-in.

name: Supabase
headline: Postgres + Auth + Storage + Realtime. 500 MB DB, 2 active projects.
free_tier_summary: Free: 500 MB Postgres, 1 GB storage, 50k MAU auth, 2 active projects. Pauses after 7 days idle.
notes: Easiest path to a full Postgres + auth stack.

name: Neon
headline: Serverless Postgres with branching. 0.5 GB storage, autoscaling compute.
free_tier_summary: Free: 0.5 GB storage, 1 always-active branch, autoscaling compute. Branch like git.
notes: Auto-scales to zero. Branching makes preview-env Postgres trivial.

name: MongoDB Atlas
headline: Hosted MongoDB free tier. 512 MB shared cluster.
free_tier_summary: M0 free cluster: 512 MB storage, shared CPU/RAM. No CC required.
notes: Standard for document-store free tier.

name: Cloudflare R2
headline: S3-compatible object storage with zero egress fees.
free_tier_summary: Free: 10 GB storage/month, 1M Class A ops, 10M Class B ops, $0 egress.
notes: Zero egress is a structural win for content-heavy apps.

name: GitHub Actions
headline: CI/CD minutes for public repos unlimited; 2,000 min/mo for private.
free_tier_summary: Public repos: unlimited. Private: 2000 Linux min/month.
notes: Default cron runner for free agentic pipelines.

name: AWS Activate
headline: Up to $100k AWS credits for eligible startups.
free_tier_summary: Activate Founders: $1k credit + 1 yr Business Support. Activate Portfolio (via VC/accelerator): up to $100k.
notes: Indian startups eligible. Apply via AWS console with company details.

name: Google Cloud for Startups
headline: Up to $200k GCP credits over 2 years.
free_tier_summary: Start tier: $2k credits + Workspace + AI tools. Scale tier: up to $200k.
notes: Indian startups eligible. Equity-free.

name: Startup India Seed Fund
headline: Indian govt seed grant up to ₹50 lakh (~$60k).
free_tier_summary: Up to ₹20 lakh as grant for proof-of-concept; up to ₹50 lakh as convertible debenture/debt.
notes: DPIIT-recognized startups only. Disbursed via incubators.

name: MeitY TIDE 2.0
headline: Indian govt incubation + grant for tech startups (AI / IoT focus).
free_tier_summary: Up to ₹4 lakh proof-of-concept + ₹7 lakh prototype grant via TIDE 2.0 incubators.
notes: Tech-focused. Apply via TIDE incubators (51 across India).

name: Y Combinator
headline: $500k investment + 3-month program. Open to global founders.
free_tier_summary: $500k on standard SAFE ($125k for 7% + $375k uncapped MFN). 3-month program. Open to global founders.
notes: Indian founders welcome. Two batches/year. Highly competitive.

name: Cerebras Cloud
headline: Very fast Llama 3.1 / 3.3 inference (~2,000+ tok/s).
free_tier_summary: Free tier on Cerebras Inference: Llama 3.1 8B / 70B + 3.3 70B with daily token cap. Sometimes via waitlist.
notes: Among fastest LLM inference; free tier subject to waitlist gates.

name: Together AI
headline: Hosted Llama / FLUX / Mixtral with $1 free credit + free serverless models.
free_tier_summary: $1 starter credit + select `Free` serverless models (Llama 8B Turbo, FLUX schnell). Pay-as-you-go after.
notes: OpenAI-compatible API. Image gen via FLUX-schnell-Free.

name: Mistral La Plateforme
headline: Mistral + Codestral + Mistral Embed free tier API.
free_tier_summary: Free tier: Mistral 7B / Mistral Small / Codestral with rate limits. Free embeddings.
notes: Strong code model. May require Indian phone for OTP.

name: NVIDIA NIM (build.nvidia.com)
headline: Generous credits across 100+ hosted models (Llama, Mistral, FLUX, Nemotron).
free_tier_summary: Free monthly credits across the NVIDIA model catalog. Many models reset daily.
notes: Huge catalog (text / vision / image / video / embed / TTS).

name: SambaNova Cloud
headline: Fast Llama 3 405B / 70B free RPD.
free_tier_summary: Free tier on SambaNova Cloud with Llama 3 405B / 70B / 8B at fast token rates.
notes: Good quality, very fast tokens. Free tier subject to fair use.

name: Replicate
headline: Hosted image / video / audio gen (FLUX, SDXL, SVD, Whisper).
free_tier_summary: Small monthly free compute. After: pay-per-second on GPU instances.
notes: Easiest one-line API for image / video. Free quota is small.

name: fal.ai
headline: Fast image + video gen (FLUX-schnell, SDXL, AnimateDiff).
free_tier_summary: Signup credits + free quota on selected fast models.
notes: Best for sub-second image generation. TTS + STT also available.

name: Voyage AI
headline: Best-in-class embeddings (voyage-3, voyage-code, multilingual).
free_tier_summary: Free tier: 50M tokens lifetime across voyage-3-lite + voyage-code + others.
notes: Strong for retrieval / RAG. Code-specific embedding models.

name: Cohere
headline: Free trial keys for embeddings + rerank + chat.
free_tier_summary: Free trial key with rate-limited access to Embed v3, Rerank, Command R. Production uses paid keys.
notes: Best free Rerank API. Trial keys; production needs paid key.

name: ElevenLabs
headline: High-quality TTS (10k characters/month free).
free_tier_summary: Free: 10,000 characters/month TTS, voice cloning limited, 3 custom voices.
notes: Best TTS quality. Free tier locks commercial use of cloned voices.

name: Deepgram
headline: STT + diarization with $200 free signup credit.
free_tier_summary: $200 signup credit (~750 hrs of Nova-2 transcription). After: pay per minute.
notes: Generous signup credit. Strong real-time STT.

name: Backblaze B2
headline: S3-compatible object storage. 10 GB free + free egress to Cloudflare.
free_tier_summary: Free: 10 GB storage, free Class B daily caps, free egress to Cloudflare via Bandwidth Alliance.
notes: Cheaper-than-S3 cold storage. Pairs well with Cloudflare R2.

name: Clerk
headline: Drop-in auth + user management with social login + 2FA.
free_tier_summary: Free: 10,000 MAU, social login, 2FA, magic links, basic user management.
notes: Pre-built React components; fastest path to working auth.

name: Auth0
headline: Identity platform with 25,000 MAU on free tier.
free_tier_summary: Free: 25,000 MAU, social + db connections, MFA, basic actions.
notes: Most generous MAU on a free tier among hosted auth.

name: Sentry
headline: Error monitoring + tracing. 5k errors / 10M spans free monthly.
free_tier_summary: Free: 5k errors, 10M tracing spans, 50 replays / month. 1 user / project. Source maps + releases.
notes: Default for JS / Python error monitoring.

name: Grafana Cloud
headline: Metrics + logs + traces. 10k Prometheus series + 50 GB logs free.
free_tier_summary: Free: 10k Prometheus series, 50 GB logs, 50 GB traces, 14-day retention. 3 user seats.
notes: Best free metrics + logs combo. 14-day retention is the catch.

name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
headline: Up to $150k Azure credits + free GitHub Enterprise + OpenAI access.
free_tier_summary: Tier 1-4 model: starts $1k Azure → up to $150k. GitHub Enterprise + Azure OpenAI access. No equity.
notes: Indian startups eligible. Equity-free. Includes Azure OpenAI access.

name: NASSCOM 10,000 Startups
headline: India's largest startup ecosystem program — mentorship + cloud credits + investor connect.
free_tier_summary: Cloud credits (AWS / Azure / GCP), mentorship, investor connects, sectoral tracks (DeepTech, AI). Multi-stage support.
notes: Run by NASSCOM. Apply via their cohort calendar.

name: Antler
headline: Day-zero VC. $100k cheque, 6-month residency program.
free_tier_summary: Stipend + $100k pre-seed cheque on graduation. Residency in major cities (Bangalore, Singapore, NY, London).
notes: Bangalore cohort runs multiple times/year. Equity-investment, not grant.

name: IndiaAI Mission (MeitY)
headline: Indian govt AI mission — compute access + grants + datasets.
free_tier_summary: Subsidised access to 10,000+ GPUs. Grants for AI startups. Free access to AI Kosh datasets + IndiaAI Innovation Centre.
notes: ₹10,372 crore allocation across 5 years. Compute via empanelled cloud partners.
